name: phil/dev-tools
description: Shared development tooling for PHIL and Tilttek packages: quality-tool configurations, Composer scripts, documentation checks and the package skeleton.

suggest.symfony/http-client: For HttpRecording, to record and replay the HTTP exchanges of integration tests (8.2 or later)
suggest.symfony/phpunit-bridge: For HttpRecording and the #[UseRecord] attribute of integration tests (8.2 or later)

scripts.infection:next: @php bin/phil-dev php next -- php bin/phil-dev infection

scripts-descriptions.bc: The public API against the latest tag, for backward-compatibility breaks.
scripts-descriptions.bench:baseline: The benchmarks, stored as the baseline of this machine.
scripts-descriptions.bench:compare: The benchmarks against the baseline, failing above the threshold of bench.threshold.
scripts-descriptions.bench:worker: A page served by FrankenPHP in worker mode, measured.
scripts-descriptions.deps:audit: The installed packages against the security advisories.
scripts-descriptions.deps:unused: The required packages the code never uses, with composer-unused.
scripts-descriptions.deptrac: The layers, generated from the composer.json and phil-dev.php of each package.
scripts-descriptions.docs: The documentation checks of each package.
scripts-descriptions.docs:lint: The prose of the documentation, with cspell, markdownlint and Vale; a script of its own.
scripts-descriptions.docs:translations: The French mirror of the documentation of each package, blocking or advisory by docs.translations.
scripts-descriptions.fuzz: The fuzz targets of the packages, each for its time budget; a script of its own.
scripts-descriptions.gates: Every quality gate, in order: the slow checks are scripts of their own.
scripts-descriptions.hooks: Installs the git hooks of captainhook.json: the fast gates on the staged files before each commit.
scripts-descriptions.hotspots: The files that change most and are the most complex, with churn-php.
scripts-descriptions.infection: Mutation testing of the whole code at 100 % of covered mutants.
scripts-descriptions.infection:changed: Mutation testing of the files changed since the base ref (PHIL_DEV_BASE_REF, else origin/main), once per batch.
scripts-descriptions.infection:next: Mutation testing of the whole code on the next PHP of the matrix, weekly and before a release.
scripts-descriptions.js: The Stimulus controllers and other scripts, checked by Biome.
scripts-descriptions.lint:apps: The container, the expressions and the YAML of each functional test application, through its own console.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: PHPStan at the maximum level, then the witnesses that prove each forbidden call is still reported.
scripts-descriptions.sbom: The CycloneDX bill of materials of each package, under var/phil-dev/sbom/.
scripts-descriptions.taint: The taint analysis of Psalm on the production code; a script of its own.
scripts-descriptions.test: The tests with ParaTest, one process per core, or PHPUnit when ParaTest is missing.
scripts-descriptions.test:next: The tests on the next PHP of the matrix, in its Docker image.
scripts-descriptions.test:services: The Integration suite against the MySQL, PostgreSQL and Gotenberg of phil-dev services.
scripts-descriptions.twig: The code style of the Twig templates, with Twig-CS-Fixer.
scripts-descriptions.twigstan: The Twig templates analysed by TwigStan; a script of its own.
